newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon unit Sept orders $1.4 billion.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon unit Sept orders $1.4 billion.

text.p: Raytheon Engineers & Constructors said on Thursday it received orders totalling $1.4 billion during September and orders worth more than $1.6 billion during the third quarter.
The company said orders booked during September included awards for major transportation, oil and gas, petrochemical, food, pulp and paper, and environmental projects.
Raytheon Engineers & Constructors is one of the four business segments of Raytheon Co.
"These new orders set records for us in terms of bookings for a single month and a single quarter," said Charles Miller, chairman and chief executive at Raytheon Engineers & Constructors.
"We were successful in winning new projects across our many product lines, and we expect that orders will also be strong in the fourth quarter," he said.
